collection_point: immediately before the ordinary PPO update
interval_basis: At the frozen 4x64 rollout, twenty updates equal 5120 environment interactions; the P0 CPU benchmark projected about 18% incremental cost at this interval while retaining resolution far below the 0.25M milestone.

gradient_objective.actor: group mean of clipped PPO policy loss minus frozen entropy coefficient
gradient_objective.critic: group mean of one-half squared return-to-value error
gradient_objective.reason: Localize PPO credit pressure without conflating intent or chain auxiliary objectives.

missing_group_rule: Emit an explicit NO_SAMPLES row with null statistics; never impute, pool, or silently drop the group.
statistical_boundary: No update-level row is an independent replicate. Mechanism decisions are seed-level, paired to UTR, and require the frozen cross-seed replication gate.
technical_pass_requires: telemetry on/off produces identical PPO update
model parameters, .grad buffers and RNG state are unchanged by telemetry
all seven group rows and all observed pair rows follow the frozen schema
missing groups are explicit and finite fields contain no NaN or Inf
append/resume does not duplicate CSV headers
default-off path passes existing PPO/DRTP regression tests
projected interval overhead is reported rather than hidden
